video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Donovan Mitchell Media Availability | 09.30.2026

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on his growth as a leader after Conference Finals
quotes.excerpt: the biggest thing for myself is continue to be a good leader
quotes.quote: The biggest thing for myself is continue to be a good leader. Making the Conference Finals for my first time in my whole career, obviously it is a step in the right direction, so double down on the habits, understand the details are so small, the margins are so small, and really paying attention to every little thing, every little rebound, defensive stop, turnover, shot, anything. I think that is what is next for myself and the group.
quotes.social_post: Donovan Mitchell says his focus after reaching the Conference Finals is to double down on habits because the margins are so small and he is paying attention to every little thing.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on Mario Hezonja's impact on the Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: Mario is strong, very strong, gets downhill, can defend, can hold his own in the paint
quotes.quote: Mario, I love Mario. He is Croatian and I played with his Croatian brother in Bojan Bogdanovic before, so that is kind of how we have our relationship. I watched the film when he was playing out here this summer too. He is talented, he is strong, very strong, gets downhill, can defend, can hold his own in the paint, and also make plays. You saw today what he was able to do in practice, being able to get downhill, being able to knock down shots. He is a big piece for us for sure.
quotes.social_post: Donovan Mitchell is impressed with new teammate Mario Hezonja calling him a big piece for the Cavs who is strong and can get downhill and knock down shots.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell names Michael Jordan as the greatest player ever
quotes.excerpt: I think Michael Jordan. I think Michael Jordan for sure.
quotes.quote: I think Michael Jordan. I think Michael Jordan for sure.
quotes.social_post: Donovan Mitchell weighs in on the GOAT debate and says he thinks Michael Jordan is for sure the greatest player ever.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on the defensive potential of the Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: adding a guy like Peyton Watson changes us in a major way
quotes.quote: I think the biggest thing is our length, our versatility. Adding a guy like Peyton Watson changes us in a major way. Obviously you have Jaylen Tyson on the perimeter as well, even Mario. Just our size, our athleticism, being able to implement different coverages, different schemes, I think will definitely be able to help us come down the stretch, not be so one-track minded defensively. And obviously having Evan and Jaylen, they do their thing back there for us as always, and they lead us. But I think with the addition of Peyton and Jaylen, I think those two are going to elevate us from the perimeter spot, and then myself, James, Sam continue to do what we do on the ball, and then obviously having those two guys behind us to protect us, protect all the mistakes, always helps.
quotes.social_post: Donovan Mitchell believes the additions of Peyton Watson and Jaylen Tyson will elevate the Cavs defense by adding length and versatility to their perimeter schemes.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on his mentorship of teammate Na'Qwan Tomlin
quotes.excerpt: Na'Qwan and I talked a lot this summer. I have sent him a lot of graphs
quotes.quote: Na'Qwan and I talked a lot this summer. I have sent him a lot of graphs that kind of show where different things about where he was in his career compared to other guys in the league. There were some things that were motivating and some things that were like, you are doing a really good job here. Understanding you have to have that relationship and build on that. I think for him, he came into camp one of our best defenders naturally, obviously, but I think he is taking that to another level. His shooting, his confidence in his shooting is obviously huge, and I am not saying he is going to come out and shoot 40 percent, and I told him that, we are not expecting you to come out and shoot 40 percent this year, that takes time and progression. But just to see how much time and effort he has put into his jump shooting is definitely an improvement, and even his decision-making as well.
quotes.social_post: Donovan Mitchell has been mentoring NaQwan Tomlin this summer sharing data to help his development and says he has seen major improvement in his jump shooting and decision making.
